title: RNA-seq of P. vivax patient isolates from Cambodia
description: Whole blood samples were collected from patients in the Kampong Speu province of western Cambodia who were 15 years or older. In this study, we aim to characterize a deletion in the 3' UTR of multidrug resistance 1 (mdr1) gene, particularly how it affects the resulting mdr1 transcript structure and levels of expression.
